# Arena Sans 13: ArenaOS's own proportional bitmap face (Phase 11.7).
#
# Drawn here, pixel by pixel; derived from no existing font. Cell height
# 13: one blank top row, then the 11 art rows below, then one blank row.
# Art row 0 is the cap/ascender top, row 8 the baseline row, rows 9-10
# descenders; x-height is 6 rows (art rows 3-8). Each glyph's art has its
# exact ink width ('#' ink, '.' empty); 1 px of spacing follows every
# glyph. Missing trailing rows are blank. `tools/gen_face13.py` turns this
# into userspace/gfxkit/src/face13.rs (checked in, regenerated by tests).
#
# Format: "= <char>" (or "= U+XXXX") then the art rows.
